from pathlib import Path
programs=base/'programs'
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    min_r = min(r for r, _ in points)
    max_r = max(r for r, _ in points)
    min_c = min(c for _, c in points)
    max_c = max(c for _, c in points)
    shape = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - (max_r - min_r + 1) + 1):
        for c in range(w - (max_c - min_c + 1) + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return out
'''
program_path=programs/f'{task}.py'
